en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Shazaan Bin Al Khaleel, from Yunus Bin Abdul Rahman, from Hammad, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
I asked himasws about the rinsing (of the mouth and the sniffing (of the water). Heasws said: ‘These two are not from the Ablution (Wudhu), they are from the (cleaning of the) inside’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Shadhan ibn al-Khalil from Yunus ibn ‘Abd al- Rahman from Hammad from abu Basir who has said the following:
“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about rinsing one’s mouth and nostrils. He (the Imam) said, ‘They are not part of Wudu’.’”
